questions.question_text: How do you create a new user in Microsoft Entra ID using the Azure portal?

options.label: A
options.text: Go to Azure AD > Users > New user

options.label: B
options.text: Go to Azure AD > Groups > New user

options.label: D
options.text: Use Azure CLI az ad user create

questions.explanation: According to Microsoft Entra ID documentation, users are created via the Azure portal under Azure AD > Users > New user.

questions.question_text: Which PowerShell cmdlet adds a user to an existing group in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: The Add-AzureADGroupMember cmdlet is described in the Microsoft Entra ID PowerShell documentation for managing group membership.

questions.question_text: Which action allows you to assign a license to a group in Microsoft Entra ID?

options.label: A
options.text: Assign license directly to a user

options.label: D
options.text: Assign license to a security group

questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID documentation states that licenses can be assigned to groups, and a security group is a valid target for license assignment.

questions.question_text: Which setting enables B2B collaboration with external organizations in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID documentation describes B2B collaboration as the feature that allows external users to be invited as guests.

questions.question_text: Which blade in the Azure portal enables self-service password reset for users?
questions.explanation: The Self-service password reset blade is documented under Azure AD > Password reset in the Microsoft Entra ID portal.

questions.question_text: Which user attribute stores the user's department information?
questions.explanation: The department attribute is defined in the Microsoft Entra ID user object schema and is used to store department information.

questions.question_text: Which group type is required to assign Microsoft 365 licenses in Microsoft Entra ID?
questions.explanation: According to Microsoft Entra ID documentation, Microsoft 365 licenses can be assigned to Microsoft 365 groups.

questions.question_text: When a user is removed from the source directory, what happens to the corresponding Microsoft Entra ID account?

options.label: A
options.text: Their Entra ID account is automatically deleted

options.label: B
options.text: Their Entra ID account remains but is disabled

options.label: C
options.text: Their Entra ID account remains but is marked as external

options.label: D
options.text: Their Entra ID account is deleted after 30 days

questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID documentation explains that cloud user accounts are retained for 30 days after source deletion before being permanently removed.

questions.question_text: Which feature allows administrators to add multiple users to a group in a single operation in the Azure portal?

options.label: C
options.text: Azure AD portal bulk edit feature

options.label: D
options.text: Azure CLI az ad group member add

questions.explanation: The Azure portal includes a bulk edit capability for managing group memberships, as described in the Microsoft Entra ID documentation.

questions.question_text: Which feature must be enabled to allow on-premises password writeback for self-service password reset?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Entra ID documentation specifies that password writeback must be enabled in Azure AD Connect to support on-premises password writeback.
